upset the balance: Bringing foreign fish into the lake could upset the balance of the local ecosystem.
把外來魚種引進湖中可能會打破當地生態系的平衡。
upset one's plans: The traffic jam upset our plans a little, so we had lunch first and visited the museum afterward.
塞車稍微打亂了我們的計畫，所以我們先吃午餐，之後才去博物館。
upset the stomach: Eating too much spicy food late at night can upset the stomach and keep you awake.
深夜吃太多辛辣食物會使胃不適，讓你睡不著。
upset the favorite: Nobody expected the small school team to upset the favorite and win the national championship.
沒有人料到這支小學校的隊伍會爆冷擊敗熱門隊伍，贏得全國冠軍。
be upset about: My little sister was upset about losing her favorite doll at the crowded night market.
我妹妹為了在擁擠的夜市弄丟她最愛的娃娃而難過。
upset the apple cart: We already have everything ready for the trip, so please don't upset the apple cart by changing the date now.
旅行的一切我們都準備好了，所以現在請不要改日期來搞砸計畫。
urge caution: Experts urge caution when using public Wi-Fi, because hackers can easily steal your personal information.
專家呼籲使用公共Wi-Fi時要謹慎，因為駭客很容易竊取你的個人資料。
urge someone to: My teacher kept urging me to apply for the English speech contest because she believed in my ability.
我的老師一直敦促我報名英語演講比賽，因為她相信我的能力。
urge restraint: Leaders on both sides urge restraint as tensions rise along the border after last night's shooting.
昨晚的槍擊事件後邊境情勢升高，雙方領袖都呼籲克制。
urge on the team: Thousands of fans came to the stadium to urge on the team during the final game of the season.
數千名球迷來到體育場，在本季最後一場比賽中為球隊加油。
urge action: Scientists urge action on climate change before rising sea levels destroy more coastal towns.
科學家呼籲在海平面上升摧毀更多沿海城鎮之前，對氣候變遷採取行動。
use one's head: If you get lost in the mountains, use your head and stay where rescuers can find you.
如果你在山裡迷路，要動腦，待在救難人員找得到你的地方。
use force: The police were told not to use force against the peaceful protesters in front of city hall.
警方被告知不得對市政府前和平的抗議者動武。
use up: Don't use up all the hot water, because three more people still need to take a shower.
不要把熱水用完，因為還有三個人要洗澡。
use someone: I finally realized that he was only trying to use me to get the answers to his homework.
我終於明白他只是想利用我來拿到他作業的答案。
could use a break: We've been studying for five hours straight, so I think we could use a break and some snacks.
我們已經連續讀了五個小時，所以我覺得我們需要休息一下，吃點零食。
use one's influence: The famous singer decided to use her influence to raise money for children in poor areas.
那位知名歌手決定動用她的影響力，為貧困地區的孩子募款。
make use of: Students should make use of the library during summer vacation to read more English books.
學生應該在暑假期間利用圖書館，多讀一些英文書。
usher in a new era: The invention of smartphones helped usher in a new era of communication around the world.
智慧型手機的發明幫助全世界開啟了通訊的新時代。
usher guests to their seats: At the wedding, my cousin's job was to usher guests to their seats before the ceremony began.
在婚禮上，我表哥的工作是在典禮開始前引導賓客入座。
usher in change: Many voters hoped the young new president would usher in change after years of slow economic growth.
在經濟多年成長緩慢之後，許多選民希望年輕的新總統能帶來改變。
usher someone out: When the meeting is over, the secretary will politely usher the visitors out of the manager's office.
會議結束時，祕書會禮貌地把訪客送出經理辦公室。
utilize resources: Schools in rural areas must utilize resources wisely because they receive less money from the government.
鄉下地區的學校必須明智地利用資源，因為他們從政府拿到的經費較少。
utilize technology: Modern farmers utilize technology such as drones to check the health of their crops.
現代農夫運用無人機等科技來檢查農作物的健康狀況。
fully utilize: To fully utilize the new library, students should learn how to search the online catalog.
為了充分利用新圖書館，學生應該學會如何搜尋線上目錄。
utilize one's skills: She found a volunteer job where she could utilize her skills in computer programming to help others.
她找到一份志工工作，可以發揮她的程式設計技能來幫助別人。
vacuum the carpet: Before the guests arrive, could you vacuum the carpet in the living room to get rid of the dog hair?
客人到之前，你可以吸一下客廳的地毯，把狗毛清掉嗎？
a power vacuum: When the king died without an heir, a power vacuum formed and several generals fought for control.
國王死後沒有繼承人，形成了權力真空，好幾位將軍爭奪控制權。
in a vacuum: Decisions about education should not be made in a vacuum without listening to teachers and parents.
教育方面的決策不應該與世隔絕地制定，而不聽取老師和家長的意見。
vacuum-packed: We bought some vacuum-packed rice cakes at the airport because they stay fresh for several weeks.
我們在機場買了一些真空包裝的年糕，因為它們可以保鮮好幾個星期。
